description: Default capabilities for the main window, which is also the multi-output manager. Desktop only — includes localhost/cleartext exceptions for local LLM servers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp). The webview/window grants below let it spawn, place, reveal and tear down output-* windows; Tauri checks those against the CALLING window, so they must live here and not in output.json. Mobile uses capabilities/mobile.json instead.
